title: .config/ianf-repo-tools.toml, version 1
description: How work reaches the trunk, and whether repo-fix leaves it alone, for repo-list and repo-fix. Each worktree goes by its own copy, as it is on disk; the trunk's integration is the copy committed on the trunk. See repo-tools' README.

version.description: The version of this file's format.

integration.description: How a branch's work reaches the trunk. direct: landed on the trunk by hand, and only the trunk pushed. pr-rebase: by pull request, branches rebased onto the trunk. pr-merge: by pull request, the trunk merged into branches.

skip-fix.description: Whether repo-fix leaves the worktree alone, while repo-list still reports what needs attention. False when left out.
